The Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL) has announced the OPTCL Junior Management Trainee Result 2026 through an official notice issued on 17 August 2026. The result is based on the Computer Based Test (CBT) held on 30 June 2026. A total of 3 candidates have been provisionally shortlisted for the next steps of the recruitment process. These shortlisted candidates will now have to appear for Document Verification and Personal Interview for the Junior Management Trainee (Civil) post. Candidates can check their roll numbers and application reference numbers in the official notice.

OPTCL Junior Management Trainee Result 2026

The OPTCL Junior Management Trainee Result 2026 includes the names and details of candidates selected for Document Verification and Personal Interview. The shortlist has been prepared using the marks of the CBT held on 30 June 2026. Candidates must remember that their selection is provisional and depends on meeting all the required eligibility conditions.

OPTCL Junior Management Trainee Result 2026 Overview

The important details of the OPTCL Junior Management Trainee Result 2026 are given in the table below. The result notice was released on 17 August 2026 for the Junior Management Trainee (Civil) post.

Particulars Details
Recruiting Organisation Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL)
Post Name Junior Management Trainee (Civil)
Advertisement No. MPPR – 08/2025-26
Advertisement Date 04 February 2026
Exam Name Computer Based Test (CBT)
CBT Exam Date 30 June 2026
Result/Notice Date 17 August 2026
Candidates Shortlisted 3
Next Stages Document Verification and Personal Interview
Selection Status Provisionally Shortlisted
Official Website optcl.co.in

 

OPTCL MT Result 2026 Download PDF Link

The OPTCL MT Result 2026 PDF has been uploaded on the official website of Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited. Candidates can download the shortlist & verify whether the Application Number, GATE Registration Number & Name appear in the list. The result has been released in PDF format so candidates do not need to enter any login credentials. Simply download the PDF & search for the application number using the search function.

OPTCL MT Result 2026 PDF: Click to Download

How to Check the OPTCL MT Result 2026?

Applicants must go to the recruitment portal at www.optcl.co.in to check the published OPTCL MT Result list. The portal features an organized setup that lets technical job seekers retrieve the results without any page errors. Follow the simple instructions and view the result :

  • Go to the authorized website homepage at www.optcl.co.in.
  • Scroll down to the bottom area & click on the “Current Openings” under the Career section.
  • Locate the link “Shortlisted Candidates List for Personal Interview for Management Trainee (Electrical)”.
  • Open the official OPTCL MT Result PDF file directly on the computer screen.
  • Use the “Ctrl + F” combination to launch the search tool.
  • Input the unique application identification string or GATE registration code to verify the qualifying status.

Details Mentioned on OPTCL MT Result 2026

The OPTCL MT Result 2026 PDF contains information related to shortlisted candidates. Candidates should verify all the details mentioned in the result carefully. The result PDF includes.

  • Application Number
  • GATE 2026 Registration Number
  • Candidate’s Name
  • Gender
  • Shortlisting Status
  • Post Name
  • Recruitment Advertisement Number

What’s Next After OPTCL MT Result 2026?

Candidates whose tracking numbers feature in the published OPTCL MT Result document must prepare for the formal personal interview stage & the document verification process immediately. The interview phase represents a 10% weightage within the overall aggregate scoring system.

The organization will upload the complete date rosters, venue locations &  time schedules on its main server very soon. Candidates must gather the educational diplomas, identity papers proofs, caste status files & passport-size photographs. Failing to present the verified original credentials during the interview check will result in disqualification.

OPTCL MT Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When did the corporation release the official OPTCL MT Result list ?

The selection committee declared the provisional candidate shortlisting list on 17th August 2026.

Q2. How many engineering candidates qualified for the interview round through the OPTCL MT Result 2026?

179 candidates met the preliminary screening to qualify for the next selection stage.

Q3. Is a password required to view the OPTCL MT Result file?

No the administrative department publishes the selection file as an open-access PDF document for all applicants.

Q4. What is the weightage of the GATE score after the OPTCL MT Result announcement?

The normalized GATE score holds a major 90% weightage while the personal interview stage covers the remaining 10% of the evaluation process.

Q5. Whom should the candidates contact if there is an issue with the name on the OPTCL MT Result 2026 sheet?

Candidates should reach out to the corporate human resources helpdesk lines via the official website contact links immediately to correct any clerical mistakes.
